instruction: Using the API, how many total email messages are in the system? Use the /api/messages endpoint without specifying a user.
Use the API to get user ID 1's profile (Lynn Blair). What is their email address?
Use the folders API for user ID 1. How many folders does Lynn Blair have?
Use the folder count API to get the inbox count for user ID 1. How many total messages are in Lynn's inbox?
Log in as 'lynn_blair' (password 'pass123') using the API. What user_id is returned?
Use the stats API for user ID 1. How many unread messages does Lynn Blair have?
Use the messages API to get user ID 2's inbox messages (user_id=2, folder=inbox). How many inbox messages does Michael Bodnar have?
Use the messages API to get user ID 1's sent messages (user_id=1, folder=sent). How many sent messages does Lynn have?
Use the search API to search for 'pipeline' across user ID 1's messages (user_id=1, q=pipeline). How many results are found?
Use the contacts API. How many unique email contacts are in the system?
Use the messages API with user_id=3 and sort=subject to get John Buchanan's messages sorted by subject. What is the subject of the first message?
Use the stats API for user ID 2. How many total messages and how many starred messages does Michael Bodnar have?
Use the messages API to get the first message (user_id=1, page=1). What is the subject of the most recent message for Lynn Blair?
Use the stats API without a user_id to get overall platform statistics. How many unique senders are there across all messages?
Using the compose API, send an email from user ID 1 to 'michael.bodnar@enron.com' with subject 'Test Message' and body 'Hello Michael'. Verify the message was sent by checking the sent folder count.
Using the API, star message ID 1 for user ID 1. Then verify the message is now starred.
Using the API, move message ID 2 to the 'trash' folder for user ID 1. Verify the message's folder changed to 'trash'.
Using the label API, add the label 'important' to message ID 3 for user ID 1. Verify the label was added.

Using the compose API, send an email from user ID 3 (John Buchanan) to 'britt.davis@enron.com' with subject 'Meeting Tomorrow' and body 'Can we meet at 3pm?'. Then check that it was delivered to user ID 4's inbox.
Using the API, mark message ID 1 as read for user ID 1, then get the stats for user ID 1. What is the updated unread count?
